### 2. Mechanisms Tied to Specific Changes

#### 2.1 Regression Gate and Auto-Revert ([`tests/test_regression_gate.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_regression_gate.py))

The `acceptance.regression.run_regression_gate` module implements a post-commit validation + revert loop:
- Runs `pytest`, `ruff`, `mypy` against a committed fix.
- On failure, calls `git revert` (configurable via `revert_on_failure=False` for dry-run).
- `scope_to_diff=True` mode: skips `ruff`/`mypy` when the commit touches no `.py` files; `mypy` is further scoped to `src/codeprobe/` only (test-only commits bypass mypy). `pytest` always runs the full suite regardless of diff.
- Line-level diff filtering for mypy: diagnostics on lines not introduced by the commit are dropped; a non-parseable non-zero exit (crash) is never dropped.
- Tests explicitly verify that pre-existing mypy errors on unchanged lines do not trigger revert.

#### 2.2 Pre-Tag Release Checks ([`scripts/pre_tag_check.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/scripts/pre_tag_check.py))

Six deterministic checks before `git tag v<version>`:
1. Two newest `verdict-NNNN.json` files must be `EVALUATED + all_pass`.
2. Both must be `eval_mode=full` (one full + one default is explicitly rejected — documented as the "one green can be luck" case).
3. Both must record a real `producer_agent` (not `e2e-stub` or `None`).
4. No `critical`/`high`-severity criterion may have `skip_reason="no_handler"` in either verdict.
5. `CHANGELOG.md` must have a `## <version>` heading.
6. The tag must not already exist.

#### 2.3 Adversarial-Fix Regression Tests ([`tests/test_dual_adversarial_fixes.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_dual_adversarial_fixes.py))

Explicitly labeled "adversarial review fixes":
- Shell metacharacter injection in verification commands is rejected at write time (`;`, `|`, `&&`, backtick, `$(...)`, `>`, `<`, newline).
- `DualScorer` weight validation rejects non-finite and out-of-range values when `scoring_policy="weighted"`.
- Strict bool parsing on serialized `scoring_details` (the `bool("False") is True` pitfall).
- Executor does not fall back to `repo_path` for stale answer artifacts in dual mode.
- Test comment documents these as fixes from "codex + copilot reviews".

#### 2.4 Scanner Refactor Tests ([`tests/test_scanner_refactor.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_scanner_refactor.py))

Covers the multi-repo scanner post-refactor: timeout, caching (`clear_scan_cache` fixture), and `scan_repo_for_family` behavior.

### 2. Mechanisms Tied to Specific Changes

#### 2.1 Regression Gate and Auto-Revert ([`tests/test_regression_gate.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_regression_gate.py))

The `acceptance.regression.run_regression_gate` module implements a post-commit validation + revert loop:
- Runs `pytest`, `ruff`, `mypy` against a committed fix.
- On failure, calls `git revert` (configurable via `revert_on_failure=False` for dry-run).
- `scope_to_diff=True` mode: skips `ruff`/`mypy` when the commit touches no `.py` files; `mypy` is further scoped to `src/codeprobe/` only (test-only commits bypass mypy). `pytest` always runs the full suite regardless of diff.
- Line-level diff filtering for mypy: diagnostics on lines not introduced by the commit are dropped; a non-parseable non-zero exit (crash) is never dropped.
- Tests explicitly verify that pre-existing mypy errors on unchanged lines do not trigger revert.

#### 2.2 Pre-Tag Release Checks ([`scripts/pre_tag_check.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/scripts/pre_tag_check.py))

Six deterministic checks before `git tag v<version>`:
1. Two newest `verdict-NNNN.json` files must be `EVALUATED + all_pass`.
2. Both must be `eval_mode=full` (one full + one default is explicitly rejected — documented as the "one green can be luck" case).
3. Both must record a real `producer_agent` (not `e2e-stub` or `None`).
4. No `critical`/`high`-severity criterion may have `skip_reason="no_handler"` in either verdict.
5. `CHANGELOG.md` must have a `## <version>` heading.
6. The tag must not already exist.

#### 2.3 Adversarial-Fix Regression Tests ([`tests/test_dual_adversarial_fixes.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_dual_adversarial_fixes.py))

Explicitly labeled "adversarial review fixes":
- Shell metacharacter injection in verification commands is rejected at write time (`;`, `|`, `&&`, backtick, `$(...)`, `>`, `<`, newline).
- `DualScorer` weight validation rejects non-finite and out-of-range values when `scoring_policy="weighted"`.
- Strict bool parsing on serialized `scoring_details` (the `bool("False") is True` pitfall).
- Executor does not fall back to `repo_path` for stale answer artifacts in dual mode.
- Test comment documents these as fixes from "codex + copilot reviews".

#### 2.4 Scanner Refactor Tests ([`tests/test_scanner_refactor.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/tests/test_scanner_refactor.py))

Covers the multi-repo scanner post-refactor: timeout, caching (`clear_scan_cache` fixture), and `scan_repo_for_family` behavior.
